signal: VitalEdge launched VitalityAI agentic suite (Mar 2026) and appointed a new CRO, Shane Martin

email.body1:
Sean, saw VitalEdge launch the VitalityAI agentic suite and bring on Shane Martin as CRO.

A new product and new revenue leadership usually mean more accounts in play globally than reps can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VitalEdge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sean, quick follow-up for VitalEdge.

With new revenue leadership setting global targets, pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your global motion needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sean, last bit of proof for VitalEdge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VitalEdge's reply rate likely compares to other dealer-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sean, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling global pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. A product launch plus new leadership is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global dealer-software motion? I'll tailor it to VitalEdge either way.
